text:
To get users to your SaaS

Comment before you post on social like X, BlueSky etc,

Spend 20-30 minutes a day leaving real replies on the 5-10 accounts your buyers follow. 

Their audience finds you before your own posts ever need to.

#SaaS #OrganicGrowth #StartupMarketing #GrowthHacking

To get you SaaS website get ranked first in Google search results,

Use tools like Serper dev

It pulls Google results into my workflows to automate keyword and competitor research.

You will know ranking keywords and know more about your competitors to beat them.

#SEO #GEO #OrganicGrowth #SaaS

Are backlinks(other websites using links to your SaaS website) dead?
 
Not quite.

The interesting thing about SEO is that links still matter, 

But where they come from, why they exist, and how naturally they fit into the web seem to matter more than ever.

#SEO #LinkBuilding #OrganicGrowth #SaaS

To analyze dozens of competing SaaS websites without manually copying their content,

Use Firecrawl, it turns websites into structured data that you can process and analyze.

Useful for researching competitors' landing pages, content strategies and website structures.

#SEO #MarketingTools #SaaS

Your SaaS website pages need Indexing

PrimeIndexer helps submit URLs for indexing, making it useful to explore when managing multiple pages.

Just remember: getting a URL submitted doesn't guarantee Google will crawl, index or rank it.

#SEO #TechnicalSEO #SaaS #BuildInPublic #IndieHacker
